title: Features: a switch didn't save
summary: DJDL's Features after turning Commerce on failed to save: the switch is back off, the row carries a danger edge and an inline line saying Commerce didn't turn on, that nothing changed, a reference id and Try again; no toast and no Commerce group in the sidebar.
compare: A switch that fails to save returns to its old position at once; the error stays on that row (role=alert) and never as a toast, and doesn't auto-dismiss (EXPERIENCE.md §7, §9).

The line says what didn't happen, that nothing changed, and a reference id; Try again repeats the same change. A refusal with a known cause says that cause and its fix instead ('Licensing was turned off at 14:02. Turn it on first.').
The sidebar is unchanged (no Commerce group), so the page and the chrome agree.
Phone: the error and Try again wrap under the requirement line.
